goal:
Implement add-edge-op-keys. Contract is the accepted design (reviews/2026-09-24-advise-5.md) and specs/edge-auth/spec.md in this change. Do not invent a second identity protocol.

Write docs/decisions/0012-direct-edge-auth.md: pin is the stable edge XID; discovery is address-only; no TOFU; no authlocal.identikey.me; keys not on btrfs.

Implement lib/mjolnir/auth/edge_keys.ex:
- Directory /var/lib/mjolnir/auth (config :auth_dir), 0700, private files 0600 at create and at open. Reject paths that resolve under btrfs_root.
- Stable identity is Ed25519. Pin is the Gordian-style XID of the inception public (document the exact bytes you hash; tests pin that function).
- Operational keys are delegated by an identikey-auth-shaped signature over dCBOR ["identikey-mjolnir/v1","op-delegation", op_pub, kid, edge_xid, purposes, nbf, exp, no_onward]. Purposes only edge-proof and cap-mint.
- Supersession is only ["identikey-mjolnir/v1","op-supersede", kid, exp_now, next_kid]. exp_now is effective revocation time, not record expiry. Late receipt still revokes. next_kid does not authorize the successor.
- Generation is not activation. Missing/corrupt op state with no stable private fails closed for direct auth.
- Stale backup is reconciliation input only. Activation needs a fresh auth-restore attestation of the reconciled output. An old attestation must not revive a superseded kid.
- Stolen stable private: new identity and new pin, not supersession of the leaked root.
- Ordinary sessions do not need the stable private online.

Tests in test/mjolnir/auth/edge_keys_test.exs for: offline chain verify, rotation overlap, snapshot path rejection, no pin is not TOFU, tampered delegation, reused kid, root-offline restart, missing state fail-closed, stale backup, stolen root, late supersession, permission-at-open.

Use a temp auth dir in tests. Do not call the network. Do not add HTTP. Do not edit add-biscuit-profiles or native/mjolnir_biscuit.

Check the open implement boxes in openspec/changes/add-edge-op-keys/tasks.md when tests pass. Edit and stop. Do not fold. Do not git push.

anchors.invariant: Host secrets stay outside btrfs_root, mode 0600
